_meta.note: Recorded by Kiro Crew's in-product frame recorder (KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES) while an AcpClient(acp_backend='pi') session ran as a crew MEMBER (member_context) on a saved agent spec, saved-member: pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.3.0 from a scratch npm prefix, the gate extension loaded through the gate launcher (PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND), and a scripted OpenAI-compatible model on the loopback interface named in pi's models.json. The spec declares tools ['*'] and one stdio MCP server, probe-server (tool echo); the saved intent was stamped with the digest a save stamps over that spec. The spec's server reached pi the way a pooled server does, as a same-named element of the per-session MCP handoff. After session/new the client confirmed the spec it consumed: AcpClient._mirrorless_member_mounts recorded the session_mcp_projection parse as _session_agent_spec, consumed_spec_matches was true, loaded_capability_template read saved-member and there were no projection gaps. One prompt then called mcp__probe_server__echo; it raised session/request_permission through the gate extension, the consumer approved it, and the probe server logged initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list and tools/call. The same drive with the spec edited after its save (description changed) was refused before its first prompt with capability_runtime_unverified, on the first spawn and on the client's one fresh-process retry, and the probe server was never asked tools/call. A third drive whose saved spec's tools list ['@other-server'] does not reference probe-server was confirmed (projection gap native_tools, so the pane reads unverified), and the pooled probe-server stub was not handed to pi: the server was never spawned and the call raised no permission request. The capture replaced only the routing's sandbox preflight (the recording host refuses user namespaces) and the gatewayd pooling (the pooled element is the spec's own entry, so the call is observable at the server); every other step ran as shipped. Scrubbed: the scratch paths are /work/proj and /work/home, uuids are placeholders, the envelope nonce is a placeholder, pi-acp's startupInfo is blanked, and 1 available_commands_update frame(s) were removed.
